body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range that has not acted this round or is Exposed. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it cannot make Reactions against you this turn.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by cover or concealment for this Action.
On a success, learn whether the target has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.

rider.title: AMBUSH CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target uses an Action that does not include you. Effect: Gain +1 die on your next Action against it before your next turn.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
